create_bpf_hash_map: create a BPF hash map with a given key type, value type, and max entries using create_map
lookup_bpf_map_entry: lookup a value in a BpfMap by key using the lookup method or bracket notation
update_bpf_map_entry: update or insert a key-value pair into a BpfMap using the update method or bracket assignment
iterate_bpf_map_keys: iterate over all keys in a BpfMap using the keys method or get the next key with get_next_key
create_bpf_queue: create a BpfQueue with a data type to collect BPF output events across all CPUs via perf event arrays
